decisions.reason: The online customer portal is far from the firm's core paper-processing knowledge and shows no signs of deeper learning or customer adoption, so the firm is likely to withdraw it and redirect resources.
Winning the German Packaging Award demonstrates strong recognition and fit with existing cardboard packaging capabilities, making it a likely keeper.

The quarter-pallet pegboard display builds directly on the firm's cardboard display expertise and has received dedicated website presentation, suggesting reasonable learning and improvement potential.
The small counter display leverages existing cardboard display know-how and has a dedicated page, indicating the firm can interpret and develop it further.
The large freestanding information display aligns with core cardboard display competencies and is presented separately, supporting continued investment.
